dct_title_s: South Africa Floods: Damage Proxy Maps, Jun 2022
dct_description_sm: # South Africa Floods: Damage Proxy Maps, Jun 2022 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for South Africa Floods (Jun 2022) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: South Africa, Floods, 4 Jun 2022, v0.9 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: South Africa, Floods, 4 Jun 2022, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:**
